name: code-frame
title: Code Frame
description: Editor chrome: a file bar with an unsaved tag and a toolbar, a line-numbered code area and an optional status bar. Static for docs and previews, or a frame to mount a real editor in.
usage:
<CodeFrame className="h-[460px]">
  <CodeFrameHeader>
    <CodeFrameTitle>strip_mine.lua</CodeFrameTitle>
    <CodeFrameTag>Unsaved</CodeFrameTag>
    <CodeFrameToolbar aria-label="File actions">
      <Button size="sm">Run on Testy</Button>
    </CodeFrameToolbar>
  </CodeFrameHeader>
  <CodeFrameBody code={source} />
</CodeFrame>
notes: CodeFrameBody with code renders static, line-numbered text and dims comment lines (--, // and #). It scrolls both ways inside the frame. To edit, leave out code and put your editor (CodeMirror, Monaco, a textarea) inside CodeFrameBody; it fills the remaining height.
CodeFrameTag takes tone warning (default), primary, success or muted. Use Code Block instead when you only need to show a snippet with a copy button.
